Reword or re-point several rubric items at once

Source: R/project.R
rubric_items_set.Rd

The bulk form of rubric_item_set(): applies a table of description and points changes in one transaction, with one automatic snapshot and one activity log entry, so a wording pass over a whole rubric is one recorded change. Every item keeps its id, position, hotkey and group, so recorded selections carry over.

Usage

rubric_items_set(changes, project = ".", snapshot = TRUE, summary = NULL)

Arguments

changes

A data frame with the columns question and item (the item's current description, matched verbatim) plus description (the new description), points (the new points) or both, where NA keeps the current value; or the path to a YAML file of such entries.

project

Path to the project directory. Defaults to the working directory.

snapshot

Whether to take an automatic snapshot before the change.

summary

Optional text recorded on the automatic snapshot and in the activity log: what the change is and why.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of the changes made, with the columns question, item (the previous description), description and points (the values now stored).

Details

Every row is checked before anything is written: the question must be in the template, item must match exactly one stored item of it, an item may be listed only once, and after all the changes no question may hold two items with the same description (so two items can swap wording in one call). Rows that change nothing are skipped. If any row fails, nothing is written.

As a YAML file, changes is a list of entries:

- question: Q1
  item: Hotel-link discovery omits usable hotel pages
  description: Some hotel pages are missed when finding hotel links
- question: Q2
  item: Plot is missing axis labels
  points: -0.5

See also

rubric_item_set(), rubric_item_delete(), snapshot_diff()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rubric_items_set(
  data.frame(
    question = c("Q1", "Q2"),
    item = c("Calculation error", "No write up"),
    description = c("The standard error divides by n", "The write-up is missing")
  ),
  project = "hw03",
  summary = "Wording review: plainer descriptions"
)
} # }
